title: The Secret Push That Could Ban TikTok

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空探索的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我要测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: American lawmakers have tried for years to ban the video app TikTok over concerns that its ties to China pose a national security risk.
sentences.zh: 多年来，美国立法者一直试图封禁视频应用TikTok，因为担心其与中国的联系构成国家安全风险。

sentences.en: Last week, they passed a law that might finally do it.
sentences.zh: 上周，他们通过了一项可能最终实现这一目标的法律。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Sapna Maheshwari, on the secret effort behind the law and what a ban would mean for the company's 170 million American users.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事萨普娜·马赫什瓦里将讲述这项法律背后的秘密工作，以及封禁对该公司1.7亿美国用户意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月30日，星期二。

sentences.en: So Sapna, tell me about this law that just passed that potentially bans the social media app TikTok.
sentences.zh: 那么萨普娜，跟我说说这项刚刚通过的、可能封禁社交媒体应用TikTok的法律吧。

sentences.en: We've seen efforts in the past to rein in TikTok, but this one really seems like the most substantial yet.
sentences.zh: 我们过去见过试图限制TikTok的努力，但这次看起来确实是最实质性的一次。

sentences.en: It's a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: What this law really does is it puts the future of this hugely popular app with 170 million American users into question.
sentences.zh: 这项法律真正做的是，让这个拥有1.7亿美国用户的热门应用的未来画上了问号。

sentences.en: TikTok has reshaped the way many people listen to music.
sentences.zh: TikTok重塑了许多人听音乐的方式。

sentences.en: It's changed the way we cook.
sentences.zh: 它改变了我们的烹饪方式。

sentences.en: It's made a whole different kind of celebrity.
sentences.zh: 它造就了一种完全不同的名人。

sentences.en: But it's never been able to shake these concerns around the fact that it has really close ties to China.
sentences.zh: 但它始终无法摆脱人们对其与中国关系密切的担忧。

sentences.en: It's owned by a Chinese company, ByteDance.
sentences.zh: 它由一家中国公司字节跳动拥有。

sentences.en: And lawmakers for years have been worried that the Chinese government could somehow use ByteDance and TikTok to get information on Americans or possibly spread propaganda.
sentences.zh: 多年来，立法者一直担心中国政府可能会以某种方式利用字节跳动和TikTok获取美国人的信息，或传播宣传内容。

sentences.en: President Trump tried to ban it in 2020.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统曾在2020年试图封禁它。

sentences.en: The state of Montana tried to ban this app last year.
sentences.zh: 蒙大拿州去年也试图封禁这款应用。

sentences.en: TikTok's largely survived those challenges.
sentences.zh: TikTok在很大程度上挺过了这些挑战。

sentences.en: But this time, it could actually be banned in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，它真的可能在美国被封禁。

sentences.en: So let's talk about this.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈这件事。

sentences.en: Why did this effort succeed where the other ones failed?
sentences.zh: 为什么这次努力成功了，而之前的却失败了？

sentences.en: It's an interesting story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的故事。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: The committee will come to order.
sentences.zh: 委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: And it really dates back to this hearing about a year ago that Congress had with Sho Chiu, the CEO of TikTok.
sentences.zh: 这其实可以追溯到大约一年前国会与TikTok首席执行官周受资举行的一场听证会。

sentences.en: Mr. Chiu, you are here because the American people need the truth about the threat TikTok poses to our national and personal security.
sentences.zh: 周先生，你今天到场是因为美国人民需要了解TikTok对我们国家和个人安全构成的威胁的真相。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 那么……

sentences.en: Members of the committee, thank you for your time.
sentences.zh: 委员会的成员们，感谢你们的时间。

sentences.en: TikTok has repeatedly said that it has addressed these national security concerns and that there's no issue here.
sentences.zh: TikTok一再表示，它已经解决了这些国家安全担忧，这里不存在问题。

sentences.en: And you can hear that when Sho Chiu testified.
sentences.zh: 当你听周受资作证时，就能听到这些。

sentences.en: Let me start by addressing a few misconceptions about ByteDance, of which we are a subsidiary.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我来澄清一下关于我们母公司字节跳动的一些误解。

sentences.en: ByteDance is not owned or controlled by the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 字节跳动不是由中国政府拥有或控制的。

sentences.en: He's saying American investors are behind ByteDance.
sentences.zh: 他在说字节跳动背后是美国投资者。

sentences.en: Now, TikTok itself is not available in mainland China.
sentences.zh: 现在，TikTok本身在中国大陆是无法使用的。

sentences.en: We're headquartered in Los Angeles and in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 我们的总部设在洛杉矶和新加坡。

sentences.en: And I myself am Singaporean.
sentences.zh: 我本人是新加坡人。

sentences.en: I live in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 我住在新加坡。

sentences.en: The bottom line is this.
sentences.zh: 底线是这样的。

sentences.en: American data stored on American soil by an American company overseen by American personnel.
sentences.zh: 美国数据由美国公司存储在美国本土，并由美国人员监管。

sentences.en: And we are actually going above and beyond what American technology companies do to keep things safe.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们所做的已经超出了美国科技公司为保障安全所采取的措施。

sentences.en: And I look forward to your questions.
sentences.zh: 我期待着回答你们的问题。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And is Congress convinced by that?
sentences.zh: 国会对此信服吗？

sentences.en: Congress is not convinced by that.
sentences.zh: 国会并不信服。

sentences.en: ByteDance is a Chinese company.
sentences.zh: 字节跳动是一家中国公司。

sentences.en: Well, ByteDance owns many businesses that operate in China.
sentences.zh: 嗯，字节跳动在中国经营着许多业务。

sentences.en: Is it or is it not a Chinese company?
sentences.zh: 它到底是不是一家中国公司？

sentences.en: Congressman, the way we look at it, it was founded by Chinese entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 议员先生，在我们看来，它是由中国企业家创立的。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: I'm not asking you how you look at it.
sentences.zh: 我不是在问你怎么看。

sentences.en: Fact.
sentences.zh: 事实。

sentences.en: Is it a Chinese company or not?
sentences.zh: 它到底是不是一家中国公司？

sentences.en: For example, Dell is a company...
sentences.zh: 比如，戴尔是一家……

sentences.en: It was this really fiery five-hour hearing where Republicans and Democrats asked really contentious questions.
sentences.zh: 那是一场非常激烈的五小时听证会，共和党人和民主党人提出了极具争议的问题。

sentences.en: We do not promote or remove content at the request of the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 我们不会应中国政府的要求推广或删除内容。

sentences.en: The question is, are you 100% certain that they cannot use your company to promote such messages?
sentences.zh: 问题是，你百分之百确定他们不能利用你们的公司来推广此类信息吗？

sentences.en: It is our commitment to this committee and all our users that we will keep this free from any manipulation by any government.
sentences.zh: 我们向本委员会及所有用户承诺，我们将使其免受任何政府的操纵。

sentences.en: If you can't say it 100% certain, I take that as a no.
sentences.zh: 如果你不能百分之百确定，我就把它当作否定回答。

sentences.en: There's this underlying sense of distrust around the company and its ties to China.
sentences.zh: 人们对该公司及其与中国的联系存在一种潜在的不信任感。

sentences.en: Search it.
sentences.zh: 去搜一下。

sentences.en: I will remind you that making false or misleading statements to Congress is a federal crime.
sentences.zh: 我要提醒你，向国会作虚假或误导性陈述是联邦罪行。

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: Again, you can go on our platform, you will find that content.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，你可以上我们的平台，你会找到那些内容。

sentences.en: And it becomes clear through the hearing that across the board, Republicans and Democrats largely feel the same way.
sentences.zh: 听证会清楚地表明，共和党人和民主党人在很大程度上有着相同的看法。

sentences.en: Mr. Chu, I got to hand it to you.
sentences.zh: 周先生，我不得不佩服你。

sentences.en: You've actually done something that in the last three to four years has not happened, except for the exception of maybe Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 你实际上做成了一件事，除了弗拉基米尔·普京之外，过去三四年里没人做到过。

sentences.en: You have unified Republicans and Democrats.
sentences.zh: 你团结了共和党人和民主党人。

sentences.en: So, you know, within weeks of this hearing, this small group of lawmakers gets together and they say,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在听证会后的几周内，这群小规模的立法者聚在一起说：

sentences.en: let's come up with a law that works where all the other ones have failed and actually make TikTok answer to its Chinese connections once and for all.
sentences.zh: 让我们制定一部有效的法律，解决其他法律失败的问题，让TikTok彻底对其中国背景负责。

sentences.en: So tell me about this small group of lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 那么跟我说说这群小规模的立法者。

sentences.en: Who are they?
sentences.zh: 他们是谁？

sentences.en: So it starts with Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这始于共和党人。

sentences.en: Among them is Steve Scalise, one of the most powerful Republicans in the House.
sentences.zh: 其中包括众议院最有权势的共和党人之一史蒂夫·斯卡利斯。

sentences.en: And a small group sort of works together for a few months.
sentences.zh: 一小群人在一起工作了几个月。

sentences.en: But they realize that in order to really make this law work, they're going to need Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但他们意识到，要真正使这项法律生效，他们需要民主党人的支持。

sentences.en: So they end up working through this House committee that's focused on China and competition.
sentences.zh: 于是他们最终通过众议院一个专注于中国和竞争的委员会开展工作。

sentences.en: And this is where the bulk of the work on this bill takes place.
sentences.zh: 这就是该法案大部分工作进行的地方。

sentences.en: And just to note, this is a really small group.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，这是一个非常小的群体。

sentences.en: There's less than 20 key players who are working on this.
sentences.zh: 参与其中的关键人物不到20人。

sentences.en: And all throughout, they are keeping this very, very secret.
sentences.zh: 而且全程他们都对此保密。

sentences.en: And why exactly are they keeping it secret?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要保密？

sentences.en: What's the point of that?
sentences.zh: 意义何在？

sentences.en: So this group really wanted to keep this out of the eyes of TikTok, which has a huge lobbying presence in D.C.
sentences.zh: 这个群体确实想避开TikTok的视线，因为TikTok在华盛顿拥有庞大的游说力量，

sentences.en: and has successfully worked to kill bills that targeted TikTok in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 并且过去曾成功阻挠了针对TikTok的法案。

sentences.en: And what they're really doing is looking at all of the past efforts to either force a sale or a ban of TikTok and trying to work their way through why those plans didn't succeed and what they can do differently.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是在审视过去所有强制出售或封禁TikTok的努力，并试图弄清楚为什么那些计划没有成功，以及他们能做些什么不同的事情。

sentences.en: But while the lawmakers are working on this bill, something big happens that kind of changes the politics around it.
sentences.zh: 但在立法者起草法案的同时，发生了一件大事，改变了围绕它的政治局势。

sentences.en: And that's October 7th.
sentences.zh: 那就是10月7日。

sentences.en: Your social media feeds are unique to you, but could they be shaping how you view the Israel-Gaza war?
sentences.zh: 你的社交媒体推送是为你量身定制的，但它们是否在塑造你对以色列-加沙战争的看法？

sentences.en: As the war breaks out and people start getting information about it, a lot of people are getting information about the Israel-Hamas war on TikTok, especially young people.
sentences.zh: 随着战争爆发，人们开始获取相关信息，许多人通过TikTok获取关于以色列-哈马斯战争的信息，尤其是年轻人。

sentences.en: Social media algorithms seem to be driving some users towards increasingly divisive posts.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体算法似乎正在将一些用户推向日益分裂的帖子。

sentences.en: And there's this big, messy argument spilling out into living rooms and all over the Internet and, of course, on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 一场巨大而混乱的争论正在蔓延到客厅、互联网上，当然还有TikTok上。

sentences.en: And it's getting very heated.
sentences.zh: 而且争论变得非常激烈。

sentences.en: For instance, there's this moment in the fall where a bunch of TikTok users start sharing this old manifesto.
sentences.zh: 例如，秋天的时候，一群TikTok用户开始分享这份旧的宣言。

sentences.en: I read Osama bin Laden's letter to America.
sentences.zh: 我读了奥萨马·本·拉登写给美国的信。

sentences.en: It's wild and everyone should read it.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了，每个人都应该读一读。

sentences.en: Go read a letter to America.
sentences.zh: 去读读那封写给美国的信。

sentences.en: Like, seriously, go read it.
sentences.zh: 我是说真的，去读读看。

sentences.en: That was actually written by Osama bin Laden, defending the 9-11 attacks and criticizing the United States' support of Israel.
sentences.zh: 那实际上是奥萨马·本·拉登写的，为9/11袭击辩护，并批评美国对以色列的支持。

sentences.en: TikTok users start trying to tie it to the modern-day conflict.
sentences.zh: TikTok用户开始试图将其与现代冲突联系起来。

sentences.en: Reading this letter, it becomes apparent to me that the actions of 9-11 were all just the buildup of our government failing other nations.
sentences.zh: 读了这封信，我清楚地意识到，9/11的行动只是我们政府辜负其他国家的结果。

sentences.en: The way this letter is going viral right now is giving me the greatest sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 这封信现在疯传的方式让我感到极大的解脱。

sentences.en: Now it's all coming to light because of Palestine.
sentences.zh: 现在因为巴勒斯坦，一切都真相大白了。

sentences.en: And there's these accusations that TikTok may be promoting one side of the conflict over the other.
sentences.zh: 还有人指责TikTok可能在冲突中偏袒一方。

sentences.en: And a couple of researchers look at hashtags around Palestine and they say that the data they pulled shows that TikTok is showing way more pro-Palestine videos and not so much for Israel.
sentences.zh: 几位研究人员查看了关于巴勒斯坦的标签，他们说他们提取的数据显示，TikTok展示了更多亲巴勒斯坦的视频，而亲以色列的则较少。

sentences.en: And this sets off huge alarm bells for this small group of lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 这为这群小规模的立法者敲响了警钟。

sentences.en: But isn't that just a function of the fact that TikTok at this point is the public square in the United States for young people?
sentences.zh: 但这难道不是因为TikTok目前是美国年轻人公共广场的事实吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this is what young people were talking about and this is where they're doing the talking.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是年轻人在谈论的话题，也是他们进行对话的地方。

sentences.en: TikTok has pushed back really forcefully against these accusations.
sentences.zh: TikTok对这些指控进行了强有力的反击。

sentences.en: They said that Gallup polls show that young people view Israel differently than older generations.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，盖洛普民意调查显示，年轻人看待以色列的方式与老一代人不同。

sentences.en: They say that they're not the ones influencing what people post, that the hashtags and the videos are a reflection of the user base and nothing that they're doing to influence.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们不是影响人们发布内容的人，标签和视频是用户群体的反映，他们并没有做任何干预。

sentences.en: But for lawmakers, this doesn't really make their concerns go away.
sentences.zh: 但对于立法者来说，这并没有消除他们的担忧。

sentences.en: Instead, this conflict shows them how TikTok could be used to spread propaganda.
sentences.zh: 相反，这场冲突让他们看到了TikTok如何被用来传播宣传。

sentences.en: It made lawmakers feel that, you know, TikTok could be really dangerous when it comes to shaping the views of Americans on foreign policy, on U.S.
sentences.zh: 这让立法者感到，TikTok在塑造美国人对外交政策和美国选举的看法方面可能非常危险。

sentences.en: elections.
sentences.zh: （接上句）

sentences.en: And what it also does is it provides this driving force to this group that's drafting this bill.
sentences.zh: 它也为起草这项法案的团队提供了动力。

sentences.en: And they suddenly see that, you know, this might be a way to bring more people into their effort.
sentences.zh: 他们突然意识到，这可能是一种吸引更多人加入他们努力的方式。

sentences.en: And so heading into November, against this backdrop, they even bring in the White House and the Justice Department to help work on this bill.
sentences.zh: 因此，进入11月，在这一背景下，他们甚至引入了白宫和司法部来协助起草这项法案。

sentences.en: And with the White House, you know, they want to make sure that this is a bill that the president will support.
sentences.zh: 有了白宫的参与，他们想确保这是一项总统会支持的法案。

sentences.en: And they work with the Justice Department to shore up the language in the bill to help defend against court challenges.
sentences.zh: 他们与司法部合作，加强了法案的措辞，以帮助抵御法庭挑战。

sentences.en: Because the Justice Department, of course, would be the one that would have to defend the bill, right?
sentences.zh: 因为司法部当然是必须为该法案辩护的一方，对吧？

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And so they're trying to make it as rock solid as possible so that they can win in court when TikTok challenges this law.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正试图使其尽可能坚如磐石，以便在TikTok挑战这项法律时能在法庭上胜诉。

sentences.en: And so March rolls around and they decide that it's time to unveil this bill that they've been working on for close to a year.
sentences.zh: 到了3月，他们决定是时候公布这项他们已经筹备了近一年的法案了。

sentences.en: The battle over TikTok on Capitol Hill is intensifying.
sentences.zh: 国会山上关于TikTok的斗争正在加剧。

sentences.en: This morning, House lawmakers have agreed unanimously to move a bill to a full floor vote.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，众议院议员一致同意将该法案提交全体投票。

sentences.en: And TikTok is caught completely flat-footed.
sentences.zh: 而TikTok完全被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: They didn't see this coming, and this is just what the group wanted.
sentences.zh: 他们没预料到这一点，而这正是该团队想要的。

sentences.en: So TikTok has this army of lobbyists that's suddenly scrambling, and they go into damage control mode.
sentences.zh: 所以TikTok那支游说大军突然乱了阵脚，进入了危机公关模式。

sentences.en: They start reaching out to members of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们开始联系国会议员。

sentences.en: This app is so much more than just an app for dumb TikTok dances.
sentences.zh: 这款应用不仅仅是用来跳那些愚蠢的TikTok舞蹈的。

sentences.en: They fly a group of TikTok stars and small businesses to come to D.C.
sentences.zh: 他们飞来了一群TikTok明星和小企业主到华盛顿。

sentences.en: And lobby on the steps of the Capitol and meet with lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 在国会大厦台阶上进行游说，并与立法者会面。

sentences.en: Standing up here with all these amazing TikTokers behind me is a complete honor.
sentences.zh: 能站在这些了不起的TikTok创作者身后，我感到无比荣幸。

sentences.en: Every single one of them would voice their opinion just like this.
sentences.zh: 他们每个人都会像这样表达自己的观点。

sentences.en: This is how we feel.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的感受。

sentences.en: This has to stop.
sentences.zh: 这一切必须停止。

sentences.en: They set up interviews between these TikTok creators, as they're known, and big TV shows and news prograMs.
sentences.zh: 他们安排了这些所谓的TikTok创作者与各大电视节目和新闻栏目进行采访。

sentences.en: And they're doing everything they can to fight against this bill before it goes any further.
sentences.zh: 他们正竭尽全力在法案进一步推进之前进行抗争。

sentences.en: And then they decide to do something unusual, which is use TikTok itself to try and derail this bill.
sentences.zh: 随后他们决定采取不同寻常的举措，即利用TikTok自身来试图阻挠这项法案。

sentences.en: How exactly do they do that?
sentences.zh: 他们具体是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: So days after this bill is announced, a ton of TikTok users get a message when they open the TikTok app that basically says, call Congress and tell them not to ban TikTok.
sentences.zh: 在该法案宣布几天后，许多TikTok用户在打开应用时收到了一条消息，大意是呼吁大家致电国会，要求他们不要封禁TikTok。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, like, literally this window comes up and says, call Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以，真的就是弹出了这样一个窗口，写着“致电国会”。

sentences.en: Here you go.
sentences.zh: 给你看看。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You can enter your zip code and there's a button that appears and you can press it and the call goes straight to your representative.
sentences.zh: 你可以输入邮政编码，然后会出现一个按钮，按下后就能直接连线到你的国会代表。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: So offices are quickly overwhelmed by calls.
sentences.zh: 于是国会办公室很快就被电话淹没了。

sentences.en: And TikTok sent out this message to users on the same day that a House committee is going in to vote on this bill and whether to move it forward.
sentences.zh: TikTok是在众议院委员会投票决定是否推进该法案的当天向用户发送这条消息的。

sentences.en: And so the stunt happens, they go in to vote and they come out and it's 50 to 0 in support of the bill.
sentences.zh: 所以这一招使出来后，他们进去投票，出来时结果是50比0，全票支持该法案。

sentences.en: One of the representatives who worked on the bill said that this stunt by TikTok turned a lot of no's into yeses and yeses into, quote, hell yeses.
sentences.zh: 其中一位参与法案起草的代表表示，TikTok的这一举动让许多原本投反对票的人转为支持，甚至让原本支持的人变成了“绝对支持”。

sentences.en: So the whole episode sounds like it actually backfired, right?
sentences.zh: 所以整件事听起来反而适得其反了，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, TikTok's stunt essentially just confirmed what was the deepest fears of lawmakers about this company, that the app could be used to influence American politics.
sentences.zh: TikTok的这一招本质上恰恰证实了立法者对这家公司最深层的担忧，即该应用可能被用来影响美国政治。

sentences.en: That's definitely how a lot of lawmakers viewed it.
sentences.zh: 很多立法者确实是这么看的。

sentences.en: And when this bill is brought to the full House a week later, it passes by an overwhelming majority.
sentences.zh: 一周后，当该法案提交众议院全体会议时，以压倒性多数获得通过。

sentences.en: And weeks later, it passes in the Senate as part of a broader aid package.
sentences.zh: 几周后，它作为更广泛援助方案的一部分在参议院获得通过。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, it's signed into law by President Biden.
sentences.zh: 周三，拜登总统签署了该法案，使其正式成为法律。

sentences.en: But now the question is, what does it mean?
sentences.zh: 但现在的问题是，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: Like, how will this actually work?
sentences.zh: 这到底会如何运作？

sentences.en: And how will it affect the tens of millions of Americans who use TikTok every day?
sentences.zh: 它又将如何影响每天使用TikTok的数千万美国人？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是Wynna Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的Connections（词汇联想）谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我负责日常创作Spelling Bee（拼字游戏）和Letterboxd游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Sapna, now that Biden has signed this bill, what does it actually mean in practice for TikTok?
sentences.zh: 那么，Sapna，现在拜登已经签署了这项法案，这对TikTok的实际意义是什么？

sentences.en: What does the law do?
sentences.zh: 这项法律具体规定了什么？

sentences.en: So, the law is really trying to push ByteDance, the company that owns TikTok, to sell to a non-Chinese owner.
sentences.zh: 法律实际上是在推动TikTok的母公司字节跳动将其出售给非中国所有者。

sentences.en: And the company basically has nine months for this sale to happen.
sentences.zh: 公司基本上有九个月的时间来完成这笔交易。

sentences.en: There's an option for President Biden to add another three months to that clock.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统可以选择将期限再延长三个月。

sentences.en: And if the company doesn't find a buyer or refuses to be sold, it will be banned.
sentences.zh: 如果公司找不到买家或拒绝出售，它将被封禁。

sentences.en: And what would a ban actually mean, Sapna?
sentences.zh: Sapna，封禁到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, people would still have the app on their phones, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，人们手机里应该还能保留这个应用，对吧？

sentences.en: So, it wouldn't, like, disappear overnight.
sentences.zh: 所以它不会一夜之间消失，对吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, no one's coming to pick up your phone and to forcibly delete this thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，没人会来收走你的手机并强行删除这个东西。

sentences.en: What the law says is that app stores and web hosting services wouldn't be allowed to carry TikTok anymore.
sentences.zh: 法律规定的是，应用商店和网络托管服务将不再被允许提供TikTok。

sentences.en: So, basically, it would kind of die a slow death over time where it wouldn't be updated and just kind of peter out.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，它会随着时间推移慢慢“死亡”，不再更新，最终逐渐消亡。

sentences.en: So, the bottom line here is that the clock has started on this potential sale, right?
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，这笔潜在交易的倒计时已经开始了，对吧？

sentences.en: They have 12 months to find a buyer.
sentences.zh: 他们有12个月的时间寻找买家。

sentences.en: So, what are the obstacles here?
sentences.zh: 那么，这里面有哪些障碍呢？

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds pretty ferociously complicated.
sentences.zh: 听起来相当复杂棘手。

sentences.en: There's a ton of challenges here, and it's a very messy choose-your-own-adventure.
sentences.zh: 这里面有无数挑战，就像一场非常混乱的“选择你的冒险”游戏。

sentences.en: So, one of the first big questions is, who could buy this?
sentences.zh: 第一个大问题是，谁能买得起？

sentences.en: ByteDance and TikTok are private.
sentences.zh: 字节跳动和TikTok是私营公司。

sentences.en: We don't know their financials.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它们的财务状况。

sentences.en: But analysts estimate that it will cost tens of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 但分析师估计，这笔交易将耗资数百亿美元。

sentences.en: That narrows the buying pool pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 这很快就缩小了潜在买家的范围。

sentences.en: And a lot of the companies that could afford to buy it, like Meta, the owner of Facebook, or Google, which owns YouTube,
sentences.zh: 而许多买得起的公司，比如Facebook的母公司Meta，或者拥有YouTube的Google，

sentences.en: would probably be, you know, kicked out of the sort of running because they are simply too big.
sentences.zh: 大概会被排除在竞争之外，因为它们实在太大了。

sentences.en: Like, regulators would say, you know, you already own these big apps.
sentences.zh: 监管机构会说，你们已经拥有这些大型应用了。

sentences.en: You can't possibly add this to your stable.
sentences.zh: 你们不可能再把这个收入囊中。

sentences.en: There'd be a monopoly concern there.
sentences.zh: 这会涉及垄断问题。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then there's a lot of questions around how this would work technically.
sentences.zh: 此外，关于这在技术上如何运作也存在很多疑问。

sentences.en: ByteDance and TikTok are very much global organizations.
sentences.zh: 字节跳动和TikTok是非常全球化的组织。

sentences.en: You have the CEO in Singapore.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官在新加坡。

sentences.en: They have huge operations in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 他们在爱尔兰有庞大的业务。

sentences.en: They have this big workforce in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们在美拥有庞大的员工队伍。

sentences.en: And, of course, they do have engineers in China.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们在中国也有工程师。

sentences.en: So, how do you, you know, extract all those things, make it all work?
sentences.zh: 所以，你该如何剥离所有这些部分，并让它正常运作呢？

sentences.en: It's a very big international transaction.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔非常庞大的国际交易。

sentences.en: And then there is the chance that the Chinese government blocks this sale and says, you cannot do this, ByteDance.
sentences.zh: 而且中国政府还有可能阻止这笔交易，对字节跳动说：你不能这么做。

sentences.en: We will not allow it.
sentences.zh: 我们不会允许的。

sentences.en: So, Sapna, how does that actually work, though, in terms of China?
sentences.zh: 那么Sapna，就中国而言，这到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: I mean, can China actually just ban the sale of this company?
sentences.zh: 中国真的能直接禁止出售这家公司吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it is a private company after all, right?
sentences.zh: 毕竟它是一家私营公司，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, here's one way it could work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一种可能的方式。

sentences.en: The Chinese government could block the export of TikTok's algorithm.
sentences.zh: 中国政府可以禁止TikTok算法的出口。

sentences.en: And let me explain that in kind of plain English.
sentences.zh: 让我用通俗易懂的话解释一下。

sentences.en: They could basically block the technology that fuels the TikTokiness of this app, the recommendations, the magic of it, why you see what you see when you're looking at TikTok.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上可以封锁支撑TikTok核心功能的技术，也就是推荐系统，那是它的魔力所在，也是你刷TikTok时看到特定内容的原因。

sentences.en: TikTokiness?
sentences.zh: “TikTok味”？

sentences.en: Is that an adjective?
sentences.zh: 那是个形容词吗？

sentences.en: That is now an adjective.
sentences.zh: 现在它是了。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: And there's a chance that Beijing could say, hey, you can't export this technology that is proprietary.
sentences.zh: 而且北京方面有可能说，嘿，你不能出口这种专有技术。

sentences.en: And if that happens, that suddenly makes TikTok way, way less valuable.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，TikTok的价值会瞬间大打折扣。

sentences.en: So, the Chinese government could let the sale go through potentially, but as a kind of an empty shell, right?
sentences.zh: 所以中国政府可能允许交易进行，但卖掉的只是一个空壳，对吧？

sentences.en: The thing that makes TikTok TikTok, the algorithm wouldn't be part of the company.
sentences.zh: 让TikTok成为TikTok的核心——算法，将不再属于该公司。

sentences.en: So, that probably isn't very appealing for a potential buyer.
sentences.zh: 这对潜在买家来说可能没什么吸引力。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, I mean, the role of the Chinese government here is really interesting.
sentences.zh: 而且，中国政府在其中的角色确实很有趣。

sentences.en: I've talked to experts who say, well, if the Chinese government interferes to try and
sentences.zh: 我和专家们聊过，他们说，如果中国政府干预并试图

sentences.en: block a sale of this app, doesn't that underscore and prove all the concerns that have been expressed by American lawmakers?
sentences.zh: 阻止该应用的出售，这难道不正好印证并证明了美国立法者所表达的所有担忧吗？

sentences.en: If you're worried about China being in control of this thing, well, that just confirmed your fears.
sentences.zh: 如果你担心中国控制这个东西，那么这正好证实了你的恐惧。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's, I mean, it's an interesting thing that ByteDance and TikTok have to grapple with.
sentences.zh: 而且，字节跳动和TikTok必须应对这一点，这很有意思。

sentences.en: So, bottom line here, selling TikTok is quite complicated and perhaps not even possible for these reasons that you're giving, right?
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，由于你提到的这些原因，出售TikTok非常复杂，甚至可能根本无法实现，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, not least of which because the Chinese government might not allow the algorithm to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 尤其是因为中国政府可能不允许算法离开中国。

sentences.en: And that's not something that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是美国

sentences.en: Congress has a lot of control over.
sentences.zh: 国会能够完全掌控的事情。

sentences.en: So, is this law fundamentally just a ban then?
sentences.zh: 那么，这项法律从根本上来说就是一项禁令吗？

sentences.en: That's what TikTok is calling it.
sentences.zh: TikTok就是这么称呼它的。

sentences.en: Right after this bill was signed into law on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 就在周三该法案签署成为法律后。

sentences.en: Make no mistake, this is a ban.
sentences.zh: 别搞错了，这就是禁令。

sentences.en: A ban on TikTok and a ban on you and your voice.
sentences.zh: 对TikTok的禁令，也是对你和你声音的禁令。

sentences.en: TikTok's CEO made a TikTok, what else?
sentences.zh: TikTok的首席执行官发了一条TikTok视频，还能发什么呢？

sentences.en: That explained the company's position.
sentences.zh: 解释了公司的立场。

sentences.en: Because the freedom of expression on TikTok reflects the same American values that make the United States a beacon of freedom.
sentences.zh: 因为TikTok上的言论自由反映了使美国成为自由灯塔的相同美国价值观。

sentences.en: He actually argued that TikTok reflects American values.
sentences.zh: 他实际上辩称TikTok反映了美国价值观。

sentences.en: TikTok gives everyday Americans a powerful way to be seen and heard.
sentences.zh: TikTok为普通美国人提供了一种强大的方式来被看见和被听见。

sentences.en: And that's why so many people have made TikTok part of their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这么多人把TikTok变成了他们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: And he said that this law infringes on the First Amendment free speech rights of Americans who love it and who use it every day.
sentences.zh: 他说这项法律侵犯了热爱并每天使用它的美国人的第一修正案言论自由权。

sentences.en: The facts and the Constitution are on our side and we expect to prevail again.
sentences.zh: 事实和宪法站在我们这一边，我们期待再次获胜。

sentences.en: So, it's very clear that TikTok plans to challenge this law in court and the court fight to follow will determine the fate of TikTok's future in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，TikTok计划在法庭上挑战这项法律，随后的法律诉讼将决定TikTok在美国的未来命运。

sentences.en: So, is that First Amendment argument that the TikTok CEO is making here going to work?
sentences.zh: 那么，TikTok首席执行官提出的第一修正案论点会奏效吗？

sentences.en: Nobody wants to put money on that.
sentences.zh: 没人敢把赌注押在这上面。

sentences.en: I mean, the company is really approaching this with the idea that the First Amendment rights of Americans are being infringed on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，公司确实是以美国人的第一修正案权利受到侵犯为由采取行动的。

sentences.en: But if you remember, the government has been working on this law.
sentences.zh: 但如果你还记得的话，政府一直在制定这项法律。

sentences.en: They've been anticipating those challenges.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在预判这些挑战。

sentences.en: And they can justify an infringing of First Amendment rights in certain cases, including with national security concerns.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，包括涉及国家安全问题时，他们可以证明侵犯第一修正案权利的合理性。

sentences.en: And so, it'll be up to a judge on whether those concerns pass muster and justify this sale and even a potential ban of TikTok.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些担忧是否站得住脚，以及是否足以证明这项出售甚至潜在的TikTok禁令的合理性，将由法官来决定。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So, TikTok will argue free speech, First Amendment, and the government will counter by saying, look, this is about China.
sentences.zh: 所以，TikTok会主张言论自由和第一修正案，而政府会反驳说，看，这是关于中国的问题。

sentences.en: This is about America's national security interests.
sentences.zh: 这是关于美国的国家安全利益。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the legal experts that I've spoken with say this is a really big and sticky area of the law and it's a huge case.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的法律专家表示，这是法律中一个非常重大且棘手的领域，这是一起巨大的案件。

sentences.en: And they really think that this will go to the Supreme Court, regardless of who wins in kind of the first round of this.
sentences.zh: 他们确实认为，无论第一轮谁赢，这最终都会闹到最高法院。

sentences.en: So, where does that leave the millions of Americans who use TikTok?
sentences.zh: 那么，这让数百万使用TikTok的美国人处于什么境地？

sentences.en: And many of them, of course, who earn a living on the platform.
sentences.zh: 当然，其中许多人还是靠这个平台谋生的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's really uncertain what happens now with the company.
sentences.zh: 公司现在的情况确实非常不确定。

sentences.en: And the clock has started ticking.
sentences.zh: 倒计时已经开始了。

sentences.en: When I looked at TikTok and looked at videos from users.
sentences.zh: 当我查看TikTok并观看用户发布的视频时。

sentences.en: This is about the impending TikTok ban.
sentences.zh: 这是关于即将到来的TikTok禁令。

sentences.en: And it just triggered me so much, makes my blood boil, and I have to get this out there.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我非常抓狂，让我怒火中烧，我必须把这些说出来。

sentences.en: There's a lot of shock.
sentences.zh: 大家感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: The most success I've had has been here on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我取得的最大成功就是在TikTok上。

sentences.en: And now they're trying to take it away.
sentences.zh: 现在他们试图把它夺走。

sentences.en: This is so stupid!
sentences.zh: 这太蠢了！

sentences.en: And anger.
sentences.zh: 还有愤怒。

sentences.en: You can't ban apps!
sentences.zh: 你们不能封禁应用！

sentences.en: You can't ban things from people!
sentences.zh: 你们不能从人们手中夺走东西！

sentences.en: People are confused.
sentences.zh: 人们感到困惑。

sentences.en: Word on the street is that in the next 9 to 12 months, TikTok could be banned.
sentences.zh: 坊间传闻，在未来9到12个月内，TikTok可能会被封禁。

sentences.en: And they're also caught a bit off guard just because there have been these years of efforts to do something about TikTok.
sentences.zh: 他们也感到有些措手不及，因为多年来一直有针对TikTok的各种行动。

sentences.en: People on the app have been hearing about a TikTok ban really since 2020.
sentences.zh: 其实自2020年以来，应用上的用户就一直在听说TikTok禁令的事。

sentences.en: Like, the government can take away a literal app on our phones and we're supposed to believe we're free?
sentences.zh: 政府竟然可以拿走我们手机里一个实实在在的应用，我们还被要求相信我们是自由的？

sentences.en: You know, a few TikTokers have said, you know, how can this be the thing that the government is pushing through so quickly?
sentences.zh: 你知道，一些TikTok创作者说，政府怎么能把这件事情推进得这么快？

sentences.en: Can we stop funding a genocide?
sentences.zh: 我们能停止资助种族灭绝吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不行。

sentences.en: Can we get free COVID tests?
sentences.zh: 我们能免费做新冠检测吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不行。

sentences.en: Can we stop killing the planet?
sentences.zh: 我们能停止破坏地球吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不行。

sentences.en: Can we at least watch videos on an app of people doing fun things and learn about the world around us?
sentences.zh: 我们至少能在一个应用上看看人们做有趣事情的视频，了解一下周围的世界吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不行。

sentences.en: So there's this sense of distrust and disappointment for many people who love this app.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于许多喜爱这个应用的人来说，存在着一种不信任感和失望感。

sentences.en: We got rid of TikTok!
sentences.zh: 我们除掉了TikTok！

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Protecting you from China!
sentences.zh: 保护你们免受中国影响！

sentences.en: You know that phone was made in China.
sentences.zh: 你知道那部手机是中国制造的吧。

sentences.en: Ah!
sentences.zh: 啊！

sentences.en: And I think there's also this question, too, around what about TikTok makes it so harmful, even though it has increasingly become a place for news.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为还有一个问题，就是TikTok到底有什么危害，尽管它已日益成为一个新闻来源。

sentences.en: There's plenty of people who simply use this app for entertainment.
sentences.zh: 有很多人仅仅是用这个应用来娱乐。

sentences.en: And what they're seeing out of Washington just doesn't square with the reality they experience when they pull out their phones.
sentences.zh: 他们从华盛顿看到的消息，与他们拿出手机时所体验到的现实完全不符。

sentences.en: And I wonder, Subna, I mean, just kind of, you know, stepping back for a second, let's say this ban on TikTok succeeds, if it goes through.
sentences.zh: Subna，我想问一下，退一步说，假设这次对TikTok的禁令成功了，如果它真的通过了。

sentences.en: Would Americans be better off?
sentences.zh: 美国人会过得更好吗？

sentences.en: It depends who you ask.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你问谁。

sentences.en: For the users who love TikTok, if it actually disappeared, it would be the government taking
sentences.zh: 对于那些喜爱TikTok的用户来说，如果它真的消失了，那将是政府夺走了

sentences.en: away a place where maybe they make money, where they get their entertainment, where they figure out what to read or what to cook next.
sentences.zh: 他们赚钱、娱乐、寻找阅读或烹饪灵感的地方。

sentences.en: To free speech advocates, this would be dystopian, unheard of for the government to crack down on an app with such wide usage by Americans.
sentences.zh: 对于言论自由倡导者来说，政府对一个被美国人广泛使用的应用进行打压，简直是反乌托邦式的，闻所未闻。

sentences.en: But for the American political class and the national security establishment, this is a necessary move, one that was years in the making, not something that was just come up
sentences.zh: 但对于美国政治阶层和国家安全机构来说，这是一项必要的举措，是筹划多年的结果，而不是一时兴起

sentences.en: with on the fly.
sentences.zh: 想出来的。

sentences.en: And ultimately, it all comes down to China.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这一切都与中国有关。

sentences.en: And this idea that you can't have a social media app like this, a source of news like this, that is even at all at risk of being influenced by the Chinese government and our
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为，你不能拥有这样一个社交媒体应用，这样一个新闻来源，它甚至存在被中国政府和我们

sentences.en: greatest adversaries.
sentences.zh: 最大的对手所影响的风险。

sentences.en: Subna, thank you.
sentences.zh: Subna，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Late Monday night, the standoff between pro-Palestinian protesters at Columbia University and the
sentences.zh: 周一深夜，哥伦比亚大学亲巴勒斯坦抗议者与

sentences.en: university's administration descended into a full-blown confrontation when students took over a university building.
sentences.zh: 校方之间的僵局演变成了一场全面的对抗，学生们占领了一栋教学楼。

sentences.en: Columbia had given students until 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚大学曾给学生们设定了下午2点的最后期限，

sentences.en: to clear out from an encampment at the center of campus, or face suspension.
sentences.zh: 要求他们撤离校园中心的营地，否则将面临停学处分。

sentences.en: It appeared to be an effort to remove the encampment without relying on New York City police.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是试图在不依赖纽约市警察的情况下清理营地。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Sharon Otterman, reporting for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是Sharon Otterman，为《纽约时报》报道。

sentences.en: A 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 下午2点，

sentences.en: deadline for protesters to clear out of the encampment at the center of Columbia
sentences.zh: 抗议者撤离哥伦比亚大学中心营地的

sentences.en: University has come and gone.
sentences.zh: 最后期限已经过了。

sentences.en: And there's still quite a large contingent inside the encampment.
sentences.zh: 营地内仍有相当多的人员留守。

sentences.en: But Monday's warning seemed only to galvanize the protesters.
sentences.zh: 但周一的警告似乎反而激怒了抗议者。

sentences.en: Several dozen of whom remained in the encampment despite the warning.
sentences.zh: 尽管有警告，仍有数十人留在营地中。

sentences.en: On Monday night, Columbia announced it had begun to suspend the students.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，哥伦比亚大学宣布已开始对学生进行停学处理。

sentences.en: Then, in the early hours of Tuesday morning, protesters took over Hamilton Hall on campus.
sentences.zh: 随后，在周二凌晨，抗议者占领了校园内的汉密尔顿大厅。

sentences.en: The student group that organized the encampment said on social media that Hamilton had been taken over by, quote, an autonomous group of Columbia University members, and that they
sentences.zh: 组织营地的学生团体在社交媒体上表示，汉密尔顿大厅已被一个“哥伦比亚大学成员组成的自治团体”占领，他们

sentences.en: would remain until the university divested from companies doing business in Israel.
sentences.zh: 将一直留守，直到学校从与以色列有业务往来的公司撤资。

sentences.en: Similar escalations broke out on campuses in the West Coast on Monday night.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，西海岸的校园也爆发了类似的升级行动。

sentences.zh: 由Mark George和Liz O'Balen编辑。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《The Daily》的内容。

sentences.zh: 我是Sabrina Tavernisi。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《The Wirecutter Show》节目，我们将为您准备假期待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡着了就人事不省。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物不耐受吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《The Wirecutter Show》。
